title: LIVE UPDATES: Rodrigo Duterte on trial at the ICC
summary: Bookmark this page for the latest developments in former president Rodrigo Duterte’s landmark trial at the International Criminal Court

blocks.text: The historic trial of former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte at the International Criminal Court (ICC) begins on Monday, November 30, as he faces charges of crimes against humanity.

The charges against Duterte stem from killings linked to his so-called war on drugs during his time as mayor of Davao City and his presidency. He is the first former Asian leader to be tried at the court in The Hague, going on trial more than a year since his pivotal arrest in March 2025.

On this page, we bring you the latest news, analyses, videos, and photos of Duterte’s trial at the ICC. For more updates and to share your own views, you can also join the Justice and Crime chat room in Rappler’s Muni app.
